## Biography

Magen Wolfe is a member of the Colonia Council who has publicly represented the regional government during the tenth-anniversary celebrations. In July 3312 she praised the supply initiative's potential to create a megamarket and boost the Colonia economy, and later confirmed that the effort had achieved partial success despite a smaller-than-hoped-for haul of rare goods.
